title: Usomaji Mwafaka (Theme 1: Darasani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child sits upright, checks the book is the right way up, and starts at the top left with a finger under the line.

floor.prerequisite: Turns the pages of a picture book one at a time.
floor.question: Fungua ukurasa unaofuata.

representations: a green dot at the top left of each page
a reading card to slide under the line
pictures of good and poor reading positions
steps: Check the book is the right way up.
Put a finger at the green dot.
Read left to right, then go down a line.
contexts: reading with a parent at home

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child shows where to start and moves his finger along the line.

misconceptions.ask: Watu walio kwenye picha wamesimama au wamepinduka?
misconceptions.repair: Shika kitabu wima: jalada mbele, picha zimesimama.

listen_for: kulala juu ya meza uso karibu na kitabu
misconceptions.ask: Kitabu kiko mbali kiasi gani na macho yako?
misconceptions.repair: Keti wima, kitabu kiwe umbali wa kiwiko hadi kiganja.

misconceptions.ask: Kidole chako kiko kwenye mstari gani?
misconceptions.repair: Mwisho wa mstari, rudi kushoto kwenye mstari unaofuata.

checks.question: Tunasoma kutoka upande gani kwenda upande gani?
Kitabu kiwe umbali gani na macho?
